description: This PHP source file defines a class ValidateResponseChecksumResultMutator that is responsible for validating checksum responses in AWS S3 SDK operations. It implements checksum validation logic as part of the AWS SDK's internal result mutator system, handling checksum verification based on response headers and operation configurations.
